20: method, record, core, data, diag = run.method, run.record, run.core, run.data, run.diag
21: PAIRS = list(itertools.combinations(range(28), 2))
22: LOOKUP = {p: k for k, p in enumerate(PAIRS)}
23: ATOL, RTOL = 2e-6, 2e-5

26: def independent_rank(values, labels, mutant=None):
27:     """Separate candidate enumeration and logaddexp formulation."""
28:     terms = []
29:     for q in range(28):
30:         ids = [LOOKUP[tuple(sorted((q, j)))] for j in range(28) if j != q]
31:         positives = [k for k in ids if labels[k]]
32:         negatives = [k for k in ids if not labels[k]]
33:         if mutant == "constant_only":
34:             term = torch.logsumexp(values[ids], 0)-values[positives].mean()-math.log(len(positives))
35:         else:
36:             if mutant == "omit_second": positives = positives[:1]
37:             pieces = []
38:             for p in positives:
39:                 ns = negatives if mutant != "other_positive_negative" else [k for k in ids if k != p]
40:                 pieces.append(torch.logaddexp(values.new_zeros(()), torch.logsumexp(values[ns], 0)-values[p]))
41:             term = torch.stack(pieces).mean()
42:         terms.append(term)
43:     return torch.stack(terms).mean()/(27 if mutant == "extra_average" else 1)
44: 
45: 
46: def analytic_rank(values, labels):
47:     """Plain Python scalar log-sum and analytical edge gradient, no production helper."""
48:     gradient = np.zeros(378, np.float64)
49:     losses, query_gradients = [], []
50:     for q in range(28):
51:         ids = [LOOKUP[tuple(sorted((q,j)))] for j in range(28) if j != q]
52:         pos, neg = [k for k in ids if labels[k]], [k for k in ids if not labels[k]]
53:         qgrad = np.zeros(378, np.float64)
54:         pieces = []
55:         for p in pos:
56:             differences = [float(values[n])-float(values[p]) for n in neg]
57:             peak = max(0., *differences)
58:             weights = [math.exp(d-peak) for d in differences]
59:             den = math.exp(-peak)+math.fsum(weights)
60:             pieces.append(peak+math.log(den))
61:             for n, w in zip(neg, weights): qgrad[n] += w/den/len(pos)
62:             qgrad[p] -= math.fsum(weights)/den/len(pos)
63:         losses.append(math.fsum(pieces)/len(pos))
64:         query_gradients.append(qgrad)
65:         gradient += qgrad/28
66:     return math.fsum(losses)/28, gradient, query_gradients
67: 
68: 
69: def independent_pool(table, slots, arm):
70:     if arm == "H_pos": return h_pool(table, slots)
71:     lookup = {p: k for k, p in enumerate(itertools.combinations(range(len(slots)), 2))}
72:     return torch.stack([table[[lookup[tuple(sorted((int(i),int(j))))]
73:         for i in np.flatnonzero(slots == a) for j in np.flatnonzero(slots == b)]].mean()
74:         for a, b in PAIRS])
75: 
76: 
77: def independent_loss(values, group):
78:     bce = torch.stack([torch.nn.functional.softplus(v)-float(group.labels[k])*v for k,v in enumerate(values)]).mean()
79:     hard = []
80:     for q in range(28):
81:         ids = [(j, LOOKUP[tuple(sorted((q,j)))]) for j in range(28) if j != q]
82:         pos = [k for j,k in ids if group.labels[k]]
83:         neg = sorted([(j,k) for j,k in ids if not group.labels[k]], key=lambda jk:(-float(values[jk[1]].detach()),jk[0]))[:5]
84:         hard.append(torch.stack([torch.nn.functional.softplus(values[n]-values[p]) for p in pos for j,n in neg]).mean())
85:     return bce+independent_rank(values, group.labels)+.5*torch.stack(hard).mean()
86: 
87: 
88: def independent_objective(table, group, seed, arm, target=None):
89:     a0, a1 = record.assignment(group), record.assignment(group, seed)
90:     v0, v1 = [independent_pool(table, slots, arm) for slots in (a0,a1)]
91:     supervised = (independent_loss(v0, group)+independent_loss(v1, group))/2
92:     return supervised if target is None else .1*supervised+.5*(v0-independent_pool(torch.as_tensor(target,device=table.device,dtype=table.dtype),a0,arm)).square().mean()

97:     memory = record.Memory("ABC")
98:     memory.retain(groups, 1, lambda g: (np.sin(np.arange(1540)/7)*2).astype(np.float32))
99:     memory.maps.update(method.metadata(arm))
100:     return memory

103: def verify_native_table(table, group, seed, reference, arm):
104:     """Actual FP32 table -> both views -> independent rank values/gradients."""
105:     rows = []
106:     for name, slots in (("A0",record.assignment(group)),("A1",record.assignment(group,seed))):
107:         scores = method.account_logits(table,slots,arm).detach().requires_grad_(True)
108:         rank = method.objectives(scores,torch.as_tensor(group.labels,device=scores.device,dtype=scores.dtype))["rank_pos"]
109:         gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(rank,scores)
110:         value, grad, _ = analytic_rank(scores.detach().double().cpu().tolist(),group.labels)
111:         np.testing.assert_allclose(float(rank.detach()),value,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
112:         np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient.detach().cpu().numpy(),grad,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
113:         rows.append(dict(view=name,value=float(rank.detach()),reference=value,gradient_max_error=float(np.max(np.abs(gradient.detach().cpu().numpy()-grad)))))
114:     return dict(arm=arm,uid=group.uid,role="history" if reference is not None else "current",views=rows)

126:     def test_rank_reference_and_rejected_mutants(self):
127:         g = handmade_group("rank")
128:         labels = np.asarray(g.labels)
129:         rows = []
130:         for dtype in (torch.float64, torch.float32):
131:             for tag, values in (("unequal",np.sin(np.arange(378)*.7)*4), ("equal",np.zeros(378)),
132:                                 ("extreme",np.where(np.arange(378)%3,1000.,-1000.))):
133:                 x = torch.tensor(values,dtype=dtype,requires_grad=True)
134:                 actual = method.objectives(x,torch.tensor(labels,dtype=dtype))["rank_pos"]
135:                 gradient, = torch.autograd.grad(actual,x)
136:                 ref, grad, qgrad = analytic_rank(x.detach().tolist(),labels)
137:                 atol,rtol = (1e-12,1e-12) if dtype == torch.float64 else (ATOL,RTOL)
138:                 np.testing.assert_allclose(float(actual.detach()),ref,atol=atol,rtol=rtol)
139:                 np.testing.assert_allclose(gradient.numpy(),grad,atol=atol,rtol=rtol)
140:                 self.assertTrue(np.all(grad[labels.astype(bool)] <= 0))
141:                 self.assertTrue(np.all(grad[~labels.astype(bool)] >= 0))
142:                 for k,(a,b) in enumerate(PAIRS): self.assertAlmostEqual(grad[k],(qgrad[a][k]+qgrad[b][k])/28,places=12)
143:                 if tag == "unequal" and dtype == torch.float64:
144:                     for k in (0,1,53,97,377):
145:                         xp,xm=values.copy(),values.copy();xp[k]+=1e-5;xm[k]-=1e-5
146:                         fd=(analytic_rank(xp,labels)[0]-analytic_rank(xm,labels)[0])/2e-5
147:                         self.assertLessEqual(abs(fd-grad[k]),2e-8)
148:                 rows.append(dict(case=tag,dtype=str(dtype),value=float(actual.detach()),reference=ref,
149:                                  gradient_max_error=float(np.max(np.abs(gradient.numpy()-grad)))))
150:         x=torch.tensor(np.sin(np.arange(378)*.7)*4,dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
151:         correct=independent_rank(x,labels);cg,=torch.autograd.grad(correct,x,retain_graph=True)
152:         rejected={}
153:         for name in ("constant_only","omit_second","other_positive_negative","extra_average"):
154:             bad=independent_rank(x,labels,name);bg,=torch.autograd.grad(bad,x,retain_graph=True)
155:             delta=float((bg-cg).abs().max());self.assertGreater(delta,1e-5);rejected[name]=delta
156:         # Real-number single-positive identity and double-positive equal-score strengthening.
157:         neg=torch.arange(26,dtype=torch.float64)/9-2;p=torch.tensor(1.3,dtype=torch.float64)
158:         torch.testing.assert_close(torch.logsumexp(torch.cat((p[None],neg)),0)-p,
159:                                   torch.logaddexp(p.new_zeros(()),torch.logsumexp(neg,0)-p),atol=1e-12,rtol=1e-12)
160:         zero=torch.zeros(378,dtype=torch.float64,requires_grad=True)
161:         old=record.parent.ranking.objectives(zero,torch.tensor(labels,dtype=zero.dtype),.5)["rank"]
162:         new=method.objectives(zero,torch.tensor(labels,dtype=zero.dtype))["rank_pos"]
163:         og,=torch.autograd.grad(old,zero,retain_graph=True);ng,=torch.autograd.grad(new,zero)
164:         # q0 and q3 are both K3; this negative edge receives two strengthened contributions.
165:         k=LOOKUP[(0,3)];self.assertGreater(float(ng[k]),float(og[k]))
166:         self.evidence("rank_reference",dict(cases=rows,rejected_mutants=rejected,undirected_two_query_gradient=True))

174:             proxy=(torch.sin(torch.arange(1540)*.39)*3).requires_grad_()

186:             observed={};tables=[]

189:                 table_observer=lambda t,g,s,r:tables.append(verify_native_table(t,g,s,r,arm)))

197:                 loss=independent_objective(table,g,seed,arm,t);losses.append(float(loss.detach()));loss.backward()
198:                 pre_errors[role]={}
199:                 for n,p in direct.named_parameters():
200:                     torch.testing.assert_close(observed[role][n],p.grad,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
201:                     pre_errors[role][n]=float((observed[role][n]-p.grad).abs().max())
202:             torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(direct.parameters(),1.)
203:             od.param_groups[0]["lr"],od.param_groups[1]["lr"]=run.parent.stage_lr(49),.001;od.step()
204:             self.assertAlmostEqual(row["total"],sum(losses),places=5)
205:             for (n,a),b in zip(model.named_parameters(),direct.parameters()):
206:                 torch.testing.assert_close(a,b,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL);torch.testing.assert_close(a.grad,b.grad,atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
207:                 for key in ("step","exp_avg","exp_avg_sq"):
208:                     torch.testing.assert_close(opt.state[a][key],od.state[b][key],atol=ATOL,rtol=RTOL)
209:             old_observed={}
210:             def old_observe(role,log):old_observed[role]={n:p.grad.clone() for n,p in old.named_parameters() if p.grad is not None}
211:             method.update(old,oo,current,history,target,c,arm,2,49,observe=old_observe,qualification_old_rank=True)
212:             effects=component_effects(model,state(old,oo),optimizer=opt)
213:             branch_delta={}
214:             for role in ("current","history"):
215:                 # History callback contains accumulated current+history; subtract current to isolate its own effect.
216:                 branch_delta[role]={}
217:                 for component in ("encoder","head"):
218:                     deltas=[]

220:                         if n.startswith(component+"."):
221:                             a=observed[role][n]-(observed["current"][n] if role=="history" else 0)
222:                             b=old_observed[role][n]-(old_observed["current"][n] if role=="history" else 0)
223:                             deltas.append(float((a-b).abs().max()))
224:                     branch_delta[role][component]=max(deltas);self.assertGreater(max(deltas),0)
225:             # Omit new history rank but retain new current: independent reference detects this fault.

229:             self.assertGreater(float((nh-oh).abs().max()),1e-5)
230:             evidence[arm]=dict(total=row["total"],independent_total=sum(losses),preclip_errors=pre_errors,

=== workspace/scripts/step28_alias_ranking.py [55..135/222] ===
55: def split_run(run_id: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
56:     if run_id not in RUNS:
57:         raise ValueError("Unknown run identity")
58:     seed, arm = run_id.split("_")
59:     return seed, arm
60: 
61: 
62: def load_model(policy: dict, seed: str, device: str = "cuda:0") -> Any:
63:     return base.load_model(reference_config(policy, seed), "split_rank", device)
64: 
65: 
66: def encoder_lr(policy: dict, arm: str, step: int) -> float:
67:     """One-based actual optimizer step; the final scheduled encoder rate is zero."""
68:     if arm not in ARMS or type(step) is not int or not 1 <= step <= policy["updates_per_run"]:
69:         raise ValueError("Unknown arm or update outside the fixed budget")
70:     if arm == "d":
71:         return 2e-5
72:     spec = policy["encoder_schedule"]
73:     warmup, total = spec["warmup_updates"], policy["updates_per_run"]
74:     if warmup != math.ceil(spec["warmup_fraction"] * total) or not 0 < warmup < total:
75:         raise ValueError("Invalid warmup schedule")
76:     factor = step / warmup if step <= warmup else (total - step) / (total - warmup)
77:     return float(spec["peak_lr"] * factor)
78: 
79: 
80: def set_learning_rate(optimizer: Any, policy: dict, arm: str, step: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
81:     if len(optimizer.param_groups) != 2:
82:         raise ValueError("Expected encoder and head optimizer groups")
83:     rates = (encoder_lr(policy, arm, step), policy["encoder_schedule"]["head_lr"])
84:     for group, rate in zip(optimizer.param_groups, rates, strict=True):
85:         group["lr"] = rate
86:     return rates
87: 
88: 
89: def hard_candidates(predicted: Any, truth: Any, count: int = 5) -> tuple[Any, Any, Any]:
90:     """Known-negative indices only, deterministic exact-tie order, live score values."""
91:     import torch
92: 
93:     if predicted.shape != (378,) or truth.shape != (378,) or count != 5:
94:         raise ValueError("Expected 28-account scores and five hard negatives")
95:     # Independent shape/label/connectivity validation remains in base.objectives.
96:     if not torch.isfinite(predicted).all() or not torch.isin(truth, truth.new_tensor([0, 1])).all():
97:         raise ValueError("Nonfinite scores or nonbinary labels")
98:     left, right = torch.triu_indices(28, 28, 1, device=predicted.device)
99:     scores = predicted.new_zeros((28, 28))
100:     scores[left, right], scores[right, left] = predicted, predicted
101:     positive = torch.zeros((28, 28), dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
102:     positive[left, right], positive[right, left] = truth.bool(), truth.bool()
103:     negative = ~positive & ~torch.eye(28, dtype=torch.bool, device=predicted.device)
104:     if (positive.sum(1) < 1).any() or (negative.sum(1) < count).any():
105:         raise ValueError("Each query needs positive and known negative candidates")
106:     selected = torch.argsort(scores.detach().masked_fill(~negative, -torch.inf),
107:                              dim=1, descending=True, stable=True)[:, :count]
108:     if not negative.gather(1, selected).all():
109:         raise ValueError("Self or positive entered hard negatives")
110:     return scores, positive, selected
111: 
112: 
113: def objectives(predicted: Any, truth: Any, hard_weight: float) -> dict:
114:     import torch
115: 
116:     if hard_weight not in (0., .5):
117:         raise ValueError("Only disabled or approved fixed hard weight is allowed")
118:     result = base.objectives(predicted, truth, 1)
119:     if hard_weight == 0:
120:         return {**result, "hard": predicted.new_zeros(())}
121:     scores, positive, selected = hard_candidates(predicted, truth)
122:     terms = []
123:     for query in range(28):
124:         pos = scores[query, positive[query]]
125:         neg = scores[query, selected[query]]
126:         terms.append(torch.nn.functional.softplus(neg.unsqueeze(0) - pos.unsqueeze(1)).mean())
127:     hard = torch.stack(terms).mean()
128:     return {"bce": result["bce"], "rank": result["rank"], "hard": hard,
129:             "total": result["total"] + hard_weight * hard}
130: 
131: 
132: def score(model: Any, groups: list, config: dict, check: Callable[[], None] = lambda: None) -> np.ndarray:
133:     return base.score(model, groups, config, "split_rank", check)
